cases.title: canonical node ID formula mismatch
cases.inputState: structurally valid Admission Plan with one tampered canonicalNodeId
cases.rationale: Every Decision ID is derived from source observation identity and generatedAt.

cases.title: missing admissionVersion
cases.inputState: Admission Plan without admissionVersion
cases.rationale: Admission Plan top-level schema is exact.

cases.title: wrong policyVersion
cases.inputState: Admission Plan with unsupported policyVersion
cases.rationale: The Admission Plan policy is fixed for v0.1.

cases.title: decisions not array
cases.inputState: Admission Plan with scalar decisions
cases.rationale: Every Candidate requires one ordered Decision.

cases.title: proposal coverage mismatch
cases.inputState: authorized decisions and nodeProposals do not partition
cases.rationale: Authorized proposal coverage must be exact.

cases.title: diagnostics mismatch
cases.inputState: Admission Plan diagnostics counts disagree
cases.rationale: Diagnostics are a deterministic partition proof.

cases.title: accepted Graph and eight Candidates
cases.inputState: accepted Graph plus accepted eight-Candidate Import Plan; all authorized
cases.rationale: The complete design example admits only authorized Evidence observations.

cases.title: missing required input key
cases.inputState: build input omits authorizedCandidateIds
cases.rationale: Authorization must be explicit; omitted is not all.

cases.title: invalid admission policy
cases.inputState: build input uses another policyVersion
cases.rationale: Only the fixed GitHub Evidence admission policy is supported.

cases.title: invalid Graph
cases.inputState: Graph fails Context Graph validation
cases.rationale: Graph validation precedes node construction.

cases.title: invalid Import Plan
cases.inputState: Import Plan fails its accepted Validator
cases.rationale: Admission accepts only a validated Import Plan.

cases.title: target project missing
cases.inputState: plan target projectId is absent from Graph
cases.rationale: Canonical scope must come from an existing Project node.

cases.title: unsupported scopeKey
cases.inputState: plan scopeKey differs from projectId
cases.rationale: GitHub admission v1 is project scoped.

cases.title: authorize only Commit Candidate
cases.inputState: eight-Candidate Plan; only the first Commit Candidate authorized
cases.rationale: Unselected Candidates remain deferred and are not proposals.

cases.title: duplicate authorization
cases.inputState: authorizedCandidateIds contains a duplicate
cases.rationale: Authorization selection is unique and exact.

cases.title: unknown authorization
cases.inputState: authorizedCandidateIds contains an unknown Candidate ID
cases.rationale: Authorization cannot refer to a Candidate outside the Plan.

cases.title: existing exact canonical Evidence
cases.inputState: Graph already contains deeply identical canonical Evidence
cases.rationale: Same observation is idempotent.

cases.title: Candidate payload binding tamper
cases.inputState: structurally valid Admission Plan; nodeProposal.payload.observedAt differs from Import Plan Candidate
cases.rationale: Standalone validation cannot prove upstream Candidate content; apply rebinds the exact Import Plan.

cases.title: apply conflict is public error
cases.inputState: Admission Plan has conflictCount > 0
cases.rationale: A conflict disposition becomes an apply-time conflict, never partial apply.

cases.title: reapply same Admission
cases.inputState: Admission applied once; rebuild against resulting Graph
cases.rationale: The same captured observations do not create duplicate nodes.

cases.title: new capture preserves history
cases.inputState: same Source Record with a different capturedAt
cases.expectedAdmission: new insert and old Evidence retained
cases.rationale: Capture time is part of observation identity; no latest-wins update.

cases.title: Evidence-only proposals
cases.inputState: all authorized Candidates are GitHub Evidence Candidates
cases.rationale: Canonical admission is not semantic promotion.

cases.title: confirmed but freshness unknown
cases.inputState: all proposals use source-local confirmation and fixed governance defaults
cases.expectedAdmission: verification confirmed; freshness unknown; personal/project_only/no confirmation
cases.rationale: Confirmed does not mean current and governance remains conservative.

cases.title: target ID is a non-project node
cases.inputState: plan target projectId resolves to an existing non-project Graph node
cases.rationale: Existing target IDs and invalid Project targets are distinct errors.

cases.title: apply authorization binding mismatch
cases.inputState: Admission Plan was built with one Candidate authorized, but Apply receives an empty authorizedCandidateIds selection.
cases.rationale: Admission Plan cannot self-prove canonical authorization; Apply rebinds the explicit selection.

cases.title: Issue does not create Action
cases.inputState: Issue Evidence Candidate is authorized
cases.rationale: Issue state is not an action instruction.

cases.title: merged PR and release do not mutate Project
cases.inputState: merged PR and published Release Candidates are authorized
cases.rationale: Source observations do not update phase, milestone or version.

cases.title: no Edge or derived mutation
cases.inputState: complete authorized admission
cases.rationale: Edges and ContextPackage are outside v0.1 admission.

cases.title: same inputs deepEqual
cases.inputState: same Graph, Plan and authorization twice
cases.rationale: No current time, randomness or array index participates.

cases.title: inputs unchanged and output frozen
cases.inputState: ordinary mutable Graph, Plan and authorization
cases.expectedAdmission: unchanged inputs; deeply frozen future output
cases.rationale: The future pure boundary isolates caller data.

cases.title: source order preserved
cases.inputState: complete authorization in Import Plan order
cases.expectedAdmission: decisions and proposals follow Candidate order
cases.rationale: Admission preserves source lineage rather than sorting by disposition.

cases.title: successful atomic Graph application
cases.inputState: accepted conflict-free Admission Plan
cases.expectedAdmission: new valid Graph with appended Evidence only
cases.rationale: Future apply appends nodes and leaves edges, metadata and package unchanged.
